# Ticketing planning Q3

Attendees: Priya Raman, Rhys Calloway, Declan Moorcroft (Kingsport FC), Hannah Varga, Aoife Brennan

- Dynamic pricing pilot (NWA-240): Hannah's demand model is ready for Kingsport FC category B and C games.
- Declan: the Kingsport board wants to approve any price that moves more than 15% from face value. The board next meets in November.
- **Decision:** pause the pilot until the board signs off. No pricing changes this season before then.
- Accessible seating booking flow (NWA-219) shipped in May. Good feedback from Kingsport FC's disability liaison officer.
- Harbour Athletic wants members to upgrade tier mid-season (Ellie to get details from Kwame).
